supportedClaims.text: VA's modernization roadmap includes improving claims processing efficiency, system resiliency, accessibility, and Section 508 compliance.
VA requires contractors providing ICT development services to supply accessibility plans and VPATs to meet Section 508 obligations.
VA has stated it will not require existing FedRAMP certification for cloud contracts, allowing post‑award security documentation instead.
VA's EHR deployment schedule shows a go‑live date at Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center in North Chicago, Illinois (VISN 3) on March 9, 2024.
Historical VA awards in NAICS 541512 have been dominated by large contractors (e.g., Oracle awards >$1.5 B, Booz Allen awards >$850 M), indicating strong competition for small businesses.
VA has deployment locations in Illinois, matching one of the offered places of performance (IL) for the opportunity.

rationale.point: Set-aside SBA matches company certification and eligibility gate passed
VA deployment location in Illinois aligns with company's place of performance (IL)
No pre-award FedRAMP certification required; post-award security documentation allowed, reducing barrier for company with no facility clearance
VA modernization roadmap includes claims processing efficiency and accessibility, aligning with company's web application experience
Historical VA awards in NAICS 541512 dominated by large contractors, indicating competitive landscape even for small-business set-asides
VA requires accessibility plans and VPATs for Section 508 compliance; company must demonstrate this capability

risks: Team of 6 engineers may be insufficient for large modernization effort; opportunity size unknown
Strong competition from other small businesses for VA set-aside work (claim 5)
Need to produce accessibility plans and VPATs per Section 508 (claim 2) without demonstrated experience
No facility clearance may complicate post-award security documentation despite FedRAMP flexibility (claim 3)
nextSteps: Review full solicitation for scope, estimated value, and evaluation criteria to assess fit with team capacity
Evaluate team's Section 508/accessibility experience; prepare sample VPATs and accessibility plan outlines
Assess readiness for post-award cloud security documentation (FedRAMP or equivalent)
Consider teaming with a VA-experienced partner to strengthen past performance and capacity
Confirm Illinois-based staff availability for potential on-site requirements at VISN 3 location (claim 4)
